compatBody: Your browser or device has WebGL disabled, so the workshop can’t be drawn. Your profile and progress are safe on this device.
compatHint: Try a current version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari, or enable hardware acceleration.
jamHint: Reload to try again. Your progress is stored locally.
sync_offline: Offline — progress is cached on this device.
tagline: Whimsical tools. One resilient dummy. Pure physics chaos.
profileGuest: Playing as a guest. Progress lives on this device.
profileSignedIn: Signed in — progress syncs to your account.
guestNote: Local guests keep full progress, boards and cosmetics on this device.
modeJourney: {n} authored stages across six chapters. Earn stars, unlock mastery stages.
modeDaily: One shared seed for everyone today. Signed in, a completed round posts to the high-score board.
modeLearn: Five hands-on lessons. One rule at a time — you do the doing.
modePractice: Any stage, your rules: undo, restarts, no pressure, unranked.
modeChallenge: Constrained goals: move limits, speed targets, restricted tools.
modeBoards: The StarHermit high-score board, your friends, and today’s records on this device.
learnIntro: Short interactive lessons. Each introduces exactly one idea — and you perform it.
diff_hard: Hard — one less of each tool
practiceNote: Practice never affects ratings or boards. Restarts and undos are free.
dailyBoardCasual: This device only (sign in to post)
noScores: No scores yet. Be the first!
noScoresDevice: No scores yet on this device. Be the first!
cosmeticsNote: Cosmetics change looks only — never hitboxes, timing, information, or power.
loopBody: Choose a tool, place or trigger it, watch the physics, satisfy the goal. Ring bells fast, hold circles, topple crates, stay airborne — every stage states its goal up front.
scoreBody: Score = goal + bonuses + spare tools + speed + style − fumbles. Ties break on completion, fewer invalid actions, then faster time.
gamepadHelp: stick or D-pad moves the cursor, A places, X triggers, B cancels, Y hints, bumpers cycle tools, Start pauses. Rebind in the StarHermit Options.
acc_reducedMotion: Reduced motion (no shake, swoops, or particle bursts)
telemetry: Share anonymous usage stats (start, tutorial steps, round ends, settings changes, error categories)
telemetryNote: No text, no pointer trails, no personal data. Aggregated only.
awayNote: While you were away ({n}s), the simulation was paused. Nothing moved.
goal_bell: Ring the bell fast enough ({speed} m/s impact)
goal_zone: Hold the dummy inside the chalk circle
goal_distance: Send the dummy {n} metres from home
goal_air: Keep the dummy airborne for {s} seconds total
contextLost: Graphics context lost — rebuilding the workshop
invalid.out-of-stock: None of that tool left in the tray.
invalid.no-mount: Pistons need a wall mount — aim for the glowing brackets.
invalid.mount-occupied: That mount already has a piston.
invalid.not-on-ground: Boing Pads must snap onto a floor or ledge.
invalid.overlap: Too close to something else — give it room.
toolBlurbs.piston: A spring-loaded wall fist. Mount it, aim it, let it rip.
toolBlurbs.pad: A squeaky trampoline puck. Snaps onto floors and ledges.
toolBlurbs.fan: Blasts a cone of air for about two seconds when triggered.
toolBlurbs.magnet: Yanks everything plush toward itself for a short while.
toolBlurbs.weight: A heavy anvil that hangs in mid-air until you drop it.
themeBlurbs.brassworks: The inventor’s home bench. Cedar, brass, and warm lamp light.
themeBlurbs.tidepool: A converted aquarium wing. Cool light, patient water.
themeBlurbs.emberworks: Where the heavy tools are born. Mind the glow.
themeBlurbs.nocturne: A rooftop lab for late ideas and quiet magnets.
themeBlurbs.verdant: Overgrown benches, patient vines, excellent light.
themeBlurbs.midnight: The inventor’s final exam room. Violet, velvet, volatile.
achDescs.first-ring: Complete any stage for the first time.
achDescs.full-toolbox: Ring a bell or finish a goal using every kind of tool.
achDescs.streak-3: Complete the daily challenge on three different days in a row.
achDescs.century-bench: Log one hundred total stage completions.
intros.j01: Mount the Wallop Piston and give the dummy a friendly shove into the bell.
intros.j02: The bell is farther now. Aim a touch higher to keep the slide alive.
intros.j03: A Boing Pad on the floor super-charges anything that skids across it.
intros.j04: Some mounts sit on the floor and fire straight up. Ring the hanging bell on the way.
intros.j05: Maximum slide. Commit to the full send.
intros.j06: The dummy is excellent at crashing into things. Topple both crates.
intros.j07: Lob the dummy so it lands inside the chalk circle and stays there.
intros.j08: Mastery: arc clean over the divider and bowl into the bell beyond.
intros.j09: The Gust Fan nudges whatever sits in its cone. Blow the dummy into the circle.
intros.j10: Stand back and let a long gust carry the dummy all the way to the bell.
intros.j11: A pad mid-gust turns a gentle push into a proper glide.
intros.j12: Keep the dummy airborne for a combined hundred ticks. Straight up works wonders.
intros.j13: The dummy is shelved. Blow it off the edge and across the floor.
intros.j14: Weaponise the breeze: the dummy becomes a very soft bowling ball.
intros.j15: A shorter gust, a smaller circle. Distance is your throttle.
intros.j16: Mastery: launch first, then catch the dummy mid-arc with a gust. Timing is everything.
intros.j17: The Thumper Weight hangs where you place it. Drop it on the stack.
intros.j18: Two towers, one anvil, dropped right between them.
intros.j19: Lob the dummy into the circle, then flatten the stack for the bonus.
intros.j20: Soften the row with the anvil, then finish with a slide.
intros.j21: Crates on the high shelf. Gravity does the paperwork.
intros.j22: One anvil, three towers. Aim for the keystone and start a chain reaction.
intros.j23: The crate fort guards the bell. Charge through it — anvils optional.
intros.j24: Mastery: the anvil clears the far stack while the dummy rings the near bell.
intros.j25: The Snatch Magnet yanks plush upward. Ring the bell on the way.
intros.j26: Hold the dummy aloft. Every floating tick counts.
intros.j27: A tall divider blocks the floor. Go over it.
intros.j28: A pit yawns between the dummy and the circle. Float across.
intros.j29: Mastery: hoist with the magnet, then blow the floating dummy across the shop.
intros.j30: Punch, then tailwind. Clear the crates and ring the bell in one flow.
intros.j31: Pop up, then let the magnet carry the climb to the high bell.
intros.j32: Mastery: every tool on the bench. Arc, gust, demolish, chime.
intros.j33: Clear the tall wall and land in the small circle beyond.
intros.j34: A mid-flight gust is the only way this parcel reaches its circle.
intros.j35: Five crates guard their bell. Topple the castle, then ring it anyway.
intros.j36: A three-metre wall says no. The magnet disagrees.
intros.j37: The client is waiting. Boosted slide, far bell, no dawdling.
intros.j38: Pluck the dummy off its shelf and deliver it to the circle, shelves to spare.
intros.j39: Demolish both stacks, then fly the coop to the bell.
intros.j40: The final commission. Every tool on the bench — but the bell only cares about results.
intros.c1: Challenge: exactly one tool use. Make it count.
intros.c2: Challenge: reach 11 m/s. The pad is your accelerator.
intros.c3: Challenge: fifteen simulated seconds. Place fast, trigger faster.
intros.c4: Challenge: one magnet, one bell, no margin for fiddling.
intros.c5: Challenge: four crates, one anvil, one drop.
intros.c6: Challenge: 180 airborne ticks. Launch, bounce, float.
intros.c7: Challenge: one launch, a tall wall, a teacup of a landing circle.
intros.c8: Challenge: three moves on the clock. Launch, lift, deliver.
intros.t2: Some mounts live on the floor and fire upward.
intros.t3: The Gust Fan blows a cone of air for about two seconds.
intros.t4: The Thumper Weight hangs in mid-air until released.
intros.t5: The Snatch Magnet pulls everything plush toward itself.
steps.t1.0: Select the Wallop Piston in the tool tray.
steps.t1.1: Place it on the glowing wall mount.
steps.t1.2: Aim toward the bell by dragging from the mount, then release (keys aim at the dummy).
steps.t1.3: Trigger the piston and watch the dummy fly!
steps.t2.0: This mount is on the floor. Place the piston on it.
steps.t2.2: Trigger it and enjoy the view.
steps.t3.0: Place the fan behind the dummy, pointing at the circle.
steps.t3.1: Trigger the fan and ride the breeze.
steps.t4.0: Place the weight above the crate stack.
steps.t5.0: Place the magnet high above the dummy.
steps.t5.1: Switch it on. Up we go!
dailyIntros.slide: One piston, one bell, one shared world. Everyone gets this exact setup today.
dailyIntros.popup: Pop the dummy into the chalk circle and keep it there.
dailyIntros.fan: A single gust stands between the dummy and the circle.
dailyIntros.magnet: Ring the high bell with nothing but magnetism.
dailyIntros.demolition: Today’s order: reduce the stack to rubble.
progressMerged: Progress restored from your StarHermit cloud save.
optionsNote: Volumes, mute, graphics quality, frame rate, language, larger text, high contrast, reduced motion and key bindings are in the StarHermit Options.
touchHelp: Pointer and touch: tap a tool in the tray, then tap or drag on the workshop to place and aim it. Tap an armed tool or its ⚡ chip to trigger it.
